## Suppress Power

---


[Bi-entity Action Types](https://origins.readthedocs.io/en/latest/types/bientity_action_types/)

Suppresses one or more powers on the __target__ entity without removing them. Suppressed powers report `isActive() == false` via a mixin, so they stop functioning but remain in the power component and resume instantly when liberated. Use [Liberate Power](https://0vergrown.github.io/Sync-Documentation-Website/?file=bientity_actions/liberate_power) to lift a suppression.

Type ID: `sync:suppress_power`

---

### Examples

```json
{
  "type":"sync:suppress_power",
  "power":"my_datapack:flight"
}
```
Suppresses a single named power on the target.

```json
{
  "type":"sync:suppress_power",
  "power_types":[
    "origins:active_self",
    "origins:cooldown"
  ],
  "ignored_powers":[
    "my_datapack:escape_ability"
  ]
}
```
Suppresses all `active_self` and `cooldown` powers except `escape_ability`.

```json
{
  "type":"sync:suppress_power",
  "power_sources":[
    "my_datapack:class_powers"
  ]
}
```
Suppresses every power that was granted from the `my_datapack:class_powers` source.

x-intellij-html-description:
title: Suppress Power (Bi-entity Action) date: 2024-01-07

Suppress Power

Bi-entity Action Types

Suppresses one or more powers on the target entity without removing them. Suppressed powers report isActive() == false via a mixin, so they stop functioning but remain in the power component and resume instantly when liberated. Use Liberate Power to lift a suppression.

Type ID: sync:suppress_power

Fields

Field Type Default Description
power Identifier optional A single power ID to suppress
powers Array of Identifier optional Additional power IDs to suppress
power_types Array of Identifier optional Factory-type IDs (e.g. origins:active_self); all powers of these types are suppressed
power_sources Array of Identifier optional Source IDs; all powers granted via a listed source are suppressed
ignored_powers Array of Identifier optional Power IDs that are never suppressed, even if they match another filter
bientity_action Bi-entity Action optional Executed once for every power that gets suppressed

Notes

  • Suppression is flat (non-stacking): calling this twice for the same power still only requires one liberate_power call to restore it.
  • If all filter fields are omitted, every power on the target is suppressed.
  • A power that matches any of the filter fields is suppressed, unless it is also in ignored_powers.
  • Suppressed powers are automatically cleaned up on player disconnect and entity death.
  • Sub-powers (children of a multiple power) share the same suppression logic and can be targeted by ID.

Examples

{
  "type":"sync:suppress_power",
  "power":"my_datapack:flight"
}

Suppresses a single named power on the target.

{
  "type":"sync:suppress_power",
  "power_types":[
    "origins:active_self",
    "origins:cooldown"
  ],
  "ignored_powers":[
    "my_datapack:escape_ability"
  ]
}

Suppresses all active_self and cooldown powers except escape_ability.

{
  "type":"sync:suppress_power",
  "power_sources":[
    "my_datapack:class_powers"
  ]
}

Suppresses every power that was granted from the my_datapack:class_powers source.
